g.text: m is 16×16 average-pooled pixel alpha a. Both conditional and empty-prompt predictions run
through the same patched branch. Pixel composition also removes VAE spill outside the mask
Exact exterior preservation is imposed by latent mixing and pixel composition; it is not a learned background-locality
